Nigerian singer, Omoniyi Raphael, popularly known as Zlatan, has released traditional photoshoot pictures with his partner, Davita Lamai. The music star posted the wedding pictures on his official Instagram page ahead of their traditional wedding ceremony, which is being held today. He wrote, “IT’s TIME TO MARRY” Celebrities, fans, and well-wishers have taken to the comments section to wish the couple a happy marriage. Influencer Enioluwa Adeoluwa wrote, “Love is a beautiful thing!
